description: Read the live GSPC board overview. Use this for declared, measured and unmeasured counts; use get_axis for one dimension and verify_card for one signed record. The default summary includes distinct count kinds, separation (TIE and UNTESTED are not wins) and source dates. detail="full" adds count grammar, family totals and the full measured_on block, preserving the legacy full payload. Fetch failure is UNREACHABLE, never a cached live result. Measurement, not certification or authority to act.

detail.description: summary (default): counts, public_count, the separation line, dates and source. full: also count_grammar, by_family and the board's measured_on block.
